question:
Nuclear density is approximately constant for all nuclei. If nuclear density is given as</br>
$$\rho=2.3\times 10^{17}\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$$</br>
estimate the nuclear radius constant $r_0$ in</br>
$$R=r_0 A^{1/3}$$</br>

Assume mass of one nucleon $m\approx 1.67\times 10^{-27}\,\text{kg}$ and treat nucleus as a sphere. Use</br>
$$\rho=\frac{\text{mass}}{\text{volume}}\approx \frac{A m}{\frac{4}{3}\pi (r_0^3 A)}=\frac{3m}{4\pi r_0^3}$$</br>
